Subject: Runtime capacity request — 2 hires (lead + sr SWE) / comp bands and offer signoff

Team —

Following our Q3 capacity planning, infra/runtime needs two hires to unblock feature rollouts and ensure service-level targets: one Runtime Lead (architect + 20% IC time) and one Senior Platform SWE. Both are backfill/expansion tied to Dedicated capacity growth and several high-priority customer projects.

Quick summary: 
- Roles: Runtime Lead (manager-of-one possibility) + Senior Platform SWE (IC4).
- Rationale: urgent backlog in kernel selection, batching, and KV-cache improvements; runway to support Dedicated customer onboarding in EU.
- Timeline: want offers live by 2026-09-10 to hit ramp in Q4.
- Compensation: attached proposed bands (comp_band_runtime_Q3_2026.pdf). Candidate in flight (external) — Alice Nguyen — indicated a target comp in mid-band for Senior SWE.

Attachments: JD_runtime_lead_v3.docx, JD_platform_swe_sr.docx, comp_band_runtime_Q3_2026.pdf

Ask: please confirm headcount budget/approval and sign off on the bands so HR can issue offers. If you want changes, suggest edits inline or reply with approval.

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel
Staff Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Runtime capacity request — 2 hires (lead + sr SWE) / comp bands and offer signoff

Dev —

Thanks for the note and materials. Quick clarifying questions before I approve: 
1) Is this fully net-new headcount (budgeted), or are we reclassifying an existing slot? I need to confirm with Finance whether this will increase our Q3 run rate.
2) For the Runtime Lead band you proposed, the midpoint is ~11% above market comp report we received last quarter (attached band shows uplift). Can you justify the uplift vs expectation for a manager-of-one hire?
3) Candidate Alice: do we have a final expected compensation ask (base + equity target + sign-on)? HiringOps is standing by but needs band confirmation.

If you can confirm #1–3 today, I can greenlight the headcount and instruct HR to prepare offers.

Marissa
Director, Talent Partnering

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity request — 2 hires (lead + sr SWE) / comp bands and offer signoff

Marissa, Dev —

I pushed the headcount ask through capacity planning this morning. Short answers: 
1) This is +2 net-new (not a reclass). Finance flagged the incremental run rate but signoff for Q3 hiring is acceptable given expected ARR expansion tied to Dedicated deals. I included a note to Finance on expected time-to-value.
2) On the Lead band: the uplift is intentional to secure a strong senior hire capable of shipping infra changes and mentoring the platform SWE. We can reduce midpoint by ~5% and leave equity slightly higher to balance cash pressure if Finance prefers.
3) Alice Nguyen is asking for $225k total cash (base + target bonus) and 0.12% equity target in the standard four-year schedule + 1.0 month sign-on; HiringOps confirmed she has competing offers. Based on market comp and her seniority that lands in upper-mid of the Senior band.

Recommendation: Approve net-new + authorize offer at upper-mid for Senior SWE (Alice) and approve Lead band with the 5% reduction to midpoint if Finance pushes back. If Laura is okay, I recommend we proceed to offer.

-Jonas
Head of Platform
